keyPoints: Samantar madhyak (mean) = sab sankhyaon ka yog ÷ kul sankhyaen — 4, 6, 8 ka madhyak (4+6+8)÷3 = 6 — ausat hamesha sabse chhoti aur sabse badi sankhya ke beech me hota hai.
Bahulak (mode) wo maan hai jo sabse zyada baar aaye — 2, 3, 3, 5 me bahulak 3 hai.
Madhyika (median) ke liye aankdon ko kram me lagao — beech wali sankhya madhyika; sam sankhyaen hon to beech ki do ka ausat lo.
Dohre dand-aalekh (double bar graph) me do samoohon ki tulna ek saath hoti hai, jaise ladke-ladkiyon ke ank — alag rang ke dande do samoohon ko darshate hain.
Prayikta (probability) me sambhavna ko ansh/har me likhte hain — sikke me chit aane ki prayikta 1/2.
Aankde ikatthe karte samay prashnavali (questionnaire) spasht honi chahiye taaki jawab tulna-yogya milen.
Aam galti: madhyika nikalte samay aankdon ko bina kram lagaye beech wali sankhya utha lena — pehle aarohi kram me sajao.
subject: Maths
title: Aankde: Ausat, Madhyika, Bahulak
